log.before: Modified Base RT = Base RT x 0.90. Affects Base RT-derived costs. Does not affect skill card RT, channel time, activation time, MP, or WT.
log.after: Modified Base RT = Base RT x 0.90. Affects every Base RT-derived per-turn cost (Move, Basic Attack, Guard, Interact, Item, Push, Rest) AND the base-RT component of weapon-WT-based Skill RT. Skill RT = round((Modified Base RT x 0.10 + Effective Weapon WT) x SkillMult), so Haste lowers only the base component (e.g. Modified Base RT 400 -> 360, base component 40 -> 36). Haste does NOT scale the Effective Weapon WT term and does NOT change the SkillMult (N) - the base component is the only part of Skill RT derived from Modified Base RT. N still multiplies the (smaller) base component, so the RT saved = 4 x N at Modified Base RT 400. Examples (Effective Weapon WT 30): Fire Bolt N 1.00: 70 -> 66; Meteor Marker N 1.40: 98 -> 92. Skills with a FIXED / level-based RT formula (e.g. round(70 + 0.25 x L)) have no base component and are unaffected. Does not affect channel time, activation time, MP, or WT. USER RULING 2026-10-04: Haste now reaches Skill RT via the base component; this SUPERSEDES the old clause 'Does not affect skill card RT', which was written for the pre-base-component (weapon-WT-only) skill RT formula. See project_rules id 136 / open_decisions #78.

log.before: Dual-buff support skill. Instant cast (no channel) — safe to use under pressure. Moderate costs. Haste doesn't affect skill RT or channel — it speeds up base recovery between actions. Regeneration stacks with itself via extend (repeated casts lengthen duration).
log.after: Dual-buff support skill. Instant cast (no channel) — safe to use under pressure. Moderate costs. Haste speeds up base recovery between actions and (USER RULING 2026-10-04) also trims the base component of weapon-WT-based Skill RT (Modified Base RT x 0.10: 40 -> 36); it does not affect channel time, Effective Weapon WT, or SkillMult, and does not change Invigorate's own fixed RT formula. Regeneration stacks with itself via extend (repeated casts lengthen duration).
